name: Inworld
description: Inworld streaming text-to-speech (MP3, OGG_OPUS, PCM telephony).

apiKey.description: Inworld API key. Must be the Base64 credential string from the Inworld dashboard (used as Authorization: Basic <apiKey>). Falls back to INWORLD_API_KEY env var.

baseUrl.description: Override Inworld API base URL (default https://api.inworld.ai).

modelId.description: TTS model id (default inworld-tts-1.5-max; also inworld-tts-2, inworld-tts-2-flash).

speakingRate.description: Speaking rate 0.5..1.5 (1.0 is the voice's native speed).

deliveryMode.description: Delivery preset, honored only by inworld-tts-2 (which ignores temperature); Inworld ignores it on other models.
